doc: Hand-checked zones of spirit_hollow/course.py (tee-shot holes) in WGS84 [lon, lat]. Zone order is kept: later zones override earlier ones (tee_strategy.lie_at); unzoned = rough. footprint_ll = the screenshot's visible map (rows 560-1980): the hand-checked map only covers that area. frame + warp: screenshot px -> frame px (render.Frame) -> WGS84 (geo_zones.ShotGeo). Built by spirit_hollow/geo_zones.py.
